heading: INT. CRUISE SHIP ENGINE ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CRUISE SHIP ENGINE ROOM - NIGHT
A cathedral of pipes and gauges.
Diesel hammer, steam hiss.
Walkways of grated steel overhang a pit where a titanic crankshaft thunders.
Heat shimmers the air.
Red emergency light.
ROMAN (40s, chief engineer, greasy coverall, wrench in his belt) stands at a panel.
BRONWEN (30s, security officer, stiff collar, radio at her hip) paces the catwalk.
CAPTAIN MBEKI (50s, white uniform, polished buttons) leans on the rail, hat low.
KESTREL (30s, stowaway, hood up, a black duffel bag) crouches by a bulkhead hatch.
Nobody's supposed to be down here.
units.name: ROMAN

units.text: That's what I told her.
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: I told you. I'm lost.
units.name: KESTREL

units.text: You are not lost.
units.name: CAPTAIN MBEKI

units.text: The radio at Bronwen's hip crackles.
Ship's engine room, this is Harbor Control. Do you copy?
units.name: HARBOR

units.text: Harbor, we copy. Standby.
units.name: BRONWEN

units.text: Be advised, authorities are boarding at dawn.
units.name: HARBOR

units.text: Mbeki straightens.
Kestrel's hand tightens on the duffel.
Roman looks from one to the other.
Who requested the boarding?
units.name: CAPTAIN MBEKI

units.text: Negative. Orders from the flag state.
units.name: HARBOR

units.text: Kestrel bolts for the ladder.
Bronwen vaults the rail and tackles her.
They crash on the grating.
The duffel bursts open and a stack of sealed documents slides across the floor.
Roman scoops up a page and reads the header.
Mbeki draws a revolver.
Nobody move.
units.name: CAPTAIN MBEKI

units.text: Everyone freezes.
Only the engine moves.
